title: SYNTHETIC Atrial Fibrillation Anticoagulation Protocol
synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC protocol for CKEA demonstration only. Not real guidance.

sections.section_text: Offer apixaban 5 mg twice daily to adults with non-valvular atrial fibrillation and a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1 or more.
Reduce apixaban to 2.5 mg twice daily if the patient meets at least two of: age 80 years or older, weight 60 kg or less, serum creatinine 133 micromol/L or above.
Apixaban is contraindicated in patients with a mechanical heart valve.
Aspirin is not used for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation.
